svgblock.title: The solar system, to (very rough) scale
svgblock.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 560 120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="sun-g" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="var(--warning)" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="var(--warning)" stop-opacity="0.4"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="60" r="22" fill="url(#sun-g)"/>
  <text x="28" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="var(--text-secondary)">Sun</text>

  <circle cx="68" cy="60" r="2.4" fill="var(--text-muted)"/>

  <text x="118" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-size="7" fill="var(--text-secondary)">♁</text>

  <circle cx="150" cy="60" r="3" fill="var(--danger)"/>
  <text x="150" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-size="7" fill="var(--text-secondary)">♂</text>

  <line x1="168" y1="45" x2="168" y2="75" stroke="var(--text-muted)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,3"/>
  <line x1="192" y1="45" x2="192" y2="75" stroke="var(--text-muted)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,3"/>

  <text x="460" y="58" font-size="8" fill="var(--text-muted)" text-anchor="middle">sizes ≈ relative</text>

</svg>
svgblock.caption: Sizes are roughly proportional; distances are heavily compressed, real gaps are millions of km.
svgblock.footer: Jupiter alone contains more mass than all other planets combined. Saturn’s rings are 99.9% water ice, and only ~10 m thick despite spanning 282,000 km.

dimensiondrawing.title: Mounting bracket — shop drawing
dimensiondrawing.caption: L-bracket profile with overall envelope and flange dimensions called out.
dimensiondrawing.footer: The dimension lines read the true profile — the drawing auto-fits to scale, so the 60×50 envelope and 18 mm flanges are exact.

explodedview.title: Flat-pack stool — exploded view
explodedview.caption: Five distinct part types thread onto the centerline in assembly order.
explodedview.footer: Eighteen pieces, five part types — the balloon numbers match the parts list so you can find each one in the box.

weldsymbol.title: Bracket-to-base weld callout
weldsymbol.caption: A 6 mm fillet on the arrow side, welded intermittently 50 long every 100.
weldsymbol.footer: The glyph below the reference line means arrow-side; 50-100 reads “50 mm of weld, centre-to-centre every 100 mm” — an intermittent fillet that saves heat and filler.

cutlist.title: Bookcase — plywood cut list
cutlist.caption: Seven parts nested onto one sheet; the leftover strip is the offcut.
cutlist.footer: All seven parts nest from a single 8×4 sheet at 82% yield — one trip to the yard, minimal waste.

spacefit.title: Living room — will it fit?
spacefit.caption: Everything fits, but the sofa-to-table gap is tighter than comfortable.
spacefit.footer: The layout works, but the 0.5 m sofa-to-table gap is flagged — below the ~0.9 m you want for an easy path; nudge the table forward 0.3 m.

anatomyfigure.title: Anatomy of the heart

pins.label: Right atrium
pins.note: Receives deoxygenated blood from the body via the venae cavae.

pins.label: Left atrium
pins.note: Receives oxygen-rich blood returning from the lungs.

pins.label: Right ventricle
pins.note: Pumps blood to the lungs through the pulmonary artery.

pins.label: Left ventricle
pins.note: The thickest chamber — drives blood out to the whole body.

pins.label: Aorta
pins.note: The main artery carrying oxygenated blood from the left ventricle.

anatomyfigure.caption: The four chambers and the great vessels, viewed from the front.

exposuretriangle.title: Portrait exposure

effects.note: Shallow depth of field — soft, blurred background.
Fast enough to freeze a small head turn.
Low ISO keeps skin tones clean and noise-free.

exposuretriangle.caption: A classic available-light portrait: wide aperture to isolate the subject, low ISO for clean tones.

brandguide.title: The São Miguel story kit
voiceNotes: Short sentences, let the landscape do the talking.
One plain claim per caption, no exclamation points.
Always name the place, never just "the island."
brandguide.footer: Apply this to every caption and thumbnail before it ships.

siteplan.title: Backyard ADU — does it clear the setbacks?
siteplan.footer: The ADU footprint clears the side and rear setbacks but overlaps the utility easement — shift it forward about 4 ft before you file.

zoningmap.title: Is the lot zoned for an ADU?
zoningmap.footer: 412 Sunset Ave sits in SF-3 residential — ADUs are allowed by-right up to 800 sq ft. The commercial corridor two blocks east doesn't apply here.

wordsearch.title: Night-sky word hunt
wordsearch.footer: Ten astronomy terms hide in all eight directions — tap a word in the list to reveal its path, or reveal them all.

playingcards.title: Reading a royal-flush draw
playingcards.note: Four cards toward the royal flush after the flop: only the 10♠ completes it (1 of the 47 unseen cards), while any of the 9 remaining spades still makes the nut flush.
playingcards.footer: A classic probability example: outs are counted against the 47 cards you haven't seen, not the whole deck.

stitchchart.title: Eyelet chevron — 8-row repeat
stitchchart.caption: Read bottom-up: right-side rows right to left, wrong-side rows left to right. WS rows purl straight across (blank cells).
stitchchart.footer: Every decrease is paired with a yarn over, so the stitch count stays at 10 on every row.

pianoroll.title: Ode to Joy — opening phrase
pianoroll.caption: Beethoven's melody stays inside five white keys — the dotted rhythm at the end shows as a long–short pair on the beat grid.
pianoroll.footer: Pitch runs bottom to top like a piano turned on its side; darker bars are played louder (higher velocity).
